observation_source: Owner report: stuck at the magenta bar, no panic text, no reset observed before the report.
observation: Magenta bar only. With t970-novc the only screen output is the last loader bar, so this is a hang rather than a panic stop.

diagnosis.finding: hostBringUpHandoff ran the command sequence without taking over the request list, so UTRLBA still addressed the firmware buffer and the first doorbell made the controller fetch foreign descriptors.
diagnosis.evidence: package/ShengUfs/T970NopTest.h stage 3 halts the queue, writes UTRLBA/UTRLBAU to the owned DMA, then restarts it before its NOP; the survey's reads ran after that sequence.
diagnosis.fix: hostBringUpHandoff now calls hostStopQueue and hostStartQueue after allocating the owned DMA and still performs no SMMU write.
diagnosis.not_established: No publication attempt was reached and no window was published; the transport itself is unchanged.
